title: Shadowbreak Ravine
wikitext:
[[Image:Shadowbreak_Ravine.jpg|thumb|Shadowbreak Ravine]]

'''Shadowbreak Ravine''' is a well-hidden area found in the mountains southeast of [[Magram Village]] in [[Desolace]]. This area is a haven for [[Burning Blade]] cultists. It holds several structures including giant mushrooms and a summoning circle with giant chains. Although there is no apparent connection between them, Shadowbreak Ravine does with its enormous mushrooms and purplish atmosphere remind much of [[Zangarmarsh]].

There are only two quests that make use of this area, Reagents for Reclaimers Inc., the [[Ley Hunter|Ley Hunters]] drop [[Felhound Brain]], as do other felhounds in Desolace, and The Infernal Orb for mages, as [[Burning Blade Summoner|Burning Blade Summoners]] drop the orbs needed. Some speculate this subzone was intended to be used in the [[warlock]] level 40 [[mount]] quest (before patch 2.4) as you can find some neutral level 40 [[felsteed]]s there. Entrance around {{coords|77|76|Desolace}}
